## Issue Link 🔗:

**Issue**: #[Issue_Number]

## Type of change

Please check all options that are relevant.

- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Experiment, model or configuration
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Dependency or tooling
- [ ] Other

## Description

- **What:** Provide an overview of the issue this PR addresses. Explain the context and background information.

- **Why:** Describe why the changes are being made. Highlight key updates, new features, or bug fixes.

- **How:** Explain how these changes will affect the project or its results, and how you tested them.

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the [contributing guide](https://github.com/danielcristho/intendiff_rag/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [code of conduct](https://github.com/danielcristho/intendiff_rag/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) of this project.
- [ ] Every commit follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Ran `make test` locally.
- [ ] A change to a prompt, configuration, capability list or decision rule has a decision entry (`D<n>`) on the `latex` branch, named in the commit body.
- [ ] No frozen release under `data/evaluation/` was edited.
- [ ] No malicious sample, archive, secret, host name or IP address is committed.
- [ ] I have updated any relevant documentation (`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.agent/`).
- [ ] I said below if an AI tool wrote a substantial part of this change.

## Additional Notes & Screenshots

Add any additional notes or comments that might be helpful for the reviewer.
